meta.note: Sample: ASDR's TaskBoard reference app assessed as if it were a client system.

roles.name: Team member
roles.distinguished_by: role chosen from a list at sign-in
roles.can: Add, tick, filter and export tasks; delete only when an admin allowed it.

roles.name: Team admin
roles.distinguished_by: role chosen from the same list at sign-in
roles.can: Everything a member can, plus add categories, decide whether members may delete, and always delete.

features.name: Sign-in with a name and a role
features.used: browser storage: user saved under taskboard.v1

features.name: Tick tasks done and the open/done counter

flows.title: A team member records and completes work
flows.outcome: Tasks are listed and ticked off; the counter shows open and done

steps.action: Signs in with a name and picks a role
steps.response: Board opens with the name and role in the top bar

steps.action: Adds a task with a category

exceptions: E1 (step 1): empty name → message, board stays closed (app/app.js:61-62)

flows.title: An admin sets up the team
flows.outcome: Categories exist and the delete rule is set

steps.response: Settings page shown to admins only
Category listed and offered when adding tasks
Settings saved; Delete appears for members

rules.text: Members can delete only when an admin allowed it; admins always can.
rules.enforcement: browser only: the Delete button is not drawn; the click handler does not re-check

rules.text: A task needs a non-empty title.

gaps.text: The 'team' board is not shared: each person's tasks live only in their own browser, so team members never see each other's work.
Admin settings (categories, delete permission) apply only on the device where they were set, not to the team.
Anyone can choose 'Team admin' at sign-in, so the admin role controls nothing.
Clearing the browser's data deletes every task; there is no backup or import, only a CSV export.

unknowns.question: Is the board meant to be shared by the whole team, or is one board per person intended?
unknowns.why: The name says 'team board' but the code keeps data per browser.

unknowns.question: Who should be allowed to be an admin, and how are people added or removed?
unknowns.why: There are no accounts; the role is self-selected.

unknowns.question: How many people and tasks should it support in a year?
unknowns.why: Sizes the move to a server and database.
